description.value: Sushi Field is a casual Japanese restaurant located in Fairfield Plaza in Victoria, offering dine-in and takeout. The restaurant emphasizes premium ingredients and chef precision in every piece of sushi. It also offers catering, making it a potential option for group cycling events.
